（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE (DETECTIVE BRANCH)）
609
2/10/16
Shanghai Municipal Council.
September 30th 1916.

Sir,
It is reported that General Yang on the 29th inst
received a telegram from General Chang Hsun instructing
him to send another deputy to Hsuchowfu. General Yang
instead of complying with the request forwarded the
telegram to Feng Kuo Chang and asked for instructions.
A detective has reported to General Yang that
during the last three days there has been secret meetings
among the military officers at Woosung. He has been
unable to ascertain the subject under discussion so far
but these meetings have been attended by two officials
from Hsuchowfu.
The meeting of dissatisfied Hunan rebels which
was reported yesterday as going to take place in two
teashops in Frenchtown has been postponed until to-day
when the venue will be the Hunan Guild, St.Catherine's
Bridge.
Zee Pou- Liang,徐璞園 native of Soochow and an
ex-police official who took a prominent part on the
rebel side in the fighting round Wusieh in the beginning of
this year is living at 19 Pau Huang Li Avenue Joffre
and his movements are being watched as he is strongly
suspected of being recruiting men for the Manchu
Restoration Party.
A number of mechanics for France were paid an
advance of 220 francs each on the 29th inst at No.1
Chih Oen Li 支先里 Rue de Consulate. They will leave
by the next French mail.

Your Obedient Servant,
William Armstrong
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

（批：30/9）

编号
（印章：上海工部局警务处（侦探股））
609
2/10/16
致上海工部局。
1916年9月30日。

先生：

据报，杨将军于本月29日收到张勋将军发来的电报，指示他再派一名副手前往徐州府。杨将军并未遵从此要求，而是将该电报转呈冯国璋，并请示指示。

一名侦探向杨将军报告称，在过去三天里，吴淞的军官们举行了秘密会议。截至目前，他尚无法查明讨论的主题，但有两名来自徐州府的官员出席了这些会议。

昨日曾报告称将在法租界两家茶馆举行的不满现状的湖南叛乱分子会议，已推迟至今日，地点改为圣凯瑟琳桥的湖南会馆。

徐璞园（Zee Pou-Liang），苏州人，前警务官员，在今年年初无锡附近的战斗中曾在叛军一方发挥重要作用，现居住于霞飞路宝康里19号。因其被强烈怀疑正在为满清复辟党招募人员，其行正受到监视。

29日，在领事馆路支先里1号，一批赴法技工每人预支了220法郎。他们将搭乘下一班法国邮船离开。

您顺从的仆人，
威廉·阿姆斯特朗
首席侦探督察长。

警察总监上尉。

（批注：30/9）
